figurative_meaning_en: Waste of words; idle or futile talk
example_sentences_in_bangla: এখন আর তাকে বোঝানো কথার শ্রাদ্ধ।
এসব আলোচনা কথার শ্রাদ্ধ হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Trying to convince him now is just a waste of words.
These discussions will turn into idle talk.
history: The idiom draws from the Hindu ritual of shraddha, performed for the deceased, implying that words offered in such contexts are ultimately futile, symbolizing pointless speech in everyday life.
note: Rooted in Hindu funeral traditions common in Bengali culture.
